review_text: I find it highly inconvenient that this app asks for verification even for a small transactions. Especially when larger financial institutions don't impose such checks for minor amounts, so I don't understand why such verification is required. This process makes the app feel less user-friendly, especially for someone who only needs the app for basic transactions. It feels like being at a shop where, after picking up an item, you're unexpectedly asked for ID proof before completing the purchase.
